What we build on the track

Eight kinds of job, one way of running them: a written schedule in week 1 and a report every Friday until the keys.

  1. 01

    Home additions

    Bedrooms, primary suites and family rooms added on, scheduled week by week from footings to final.

    Price this job
  2. 02

    Kitchen remodels

    Walls moved, plumbing and wiring redone and cabinets set, with a temporary kitchen planned for you.

    Price this job
  3. 03

    Bathroom remodels

    Down to the studs, new waterproofing and tile, with your no-shower dates written down ahead.

    Price this job
  4. 04

    Whole-home renovations

    Older bungalows and ranches reworked inside, planned in phases so you know when you can move back.

    Price this job
  5. 05

    Second-story additions

    A new floor on a one-story house, checked by an engineer before any roof comes off.

    Price this job
  6. 06

    Permits and inspections

    We pull the permits, book every inspection and put each date on your weekly report.

    Price this job
  7. 07

    Porches and screened rooms

    Covered porches and screened rooms tied into the roof, framed and finished to match the house.

    Price this job
  8. 08

    Weekly site reports

    Every Friday: what got done, what is next, site photos and any decisions we need from you.

This is the Friday report

One page, sent before the crew leaves on Friday. Tap through the three parts of a sample week.

Fri · WK 09 · kitchen remodel Sample report

Done this week

  • Rough plumbing passed inspection on Tuesday
  • Soffits framed and wired for the new lights
  • Temporary sink moved to the dining room

Next week

  • Mon–Tue: drywall hung and taped
  • Wed: cabinet maker on site to template
  • Thu: tile delivery, stored in the garage

From you by Monday

  • Grout color (three samples in the box by the door)
  • Appliance model numbers for the cutouts
  • OK for the electrician to start at 7 on Wednesday

What people said about the Fridays

4.9 ★ · 57 reviews Sample rating

  • 01

    Weekly site reports

    Our addition took twenty-two weeks and I got twenty-two Friday reports. Each one had photos, what was done, and what they needed from us by Monday. When the framing inspection slipped a week, the report said so before I could ask.

    Caroline H. · Nashville Sample review

  • 02

    Home additions

    We added a primary suite to our 1950s ranch in Brentwood. Rhett walked us through the schedule on day one, and the walk-through happened four days later than the plan said, not four months.

    Jamal W. · Brentwood Sample review

  • 03

    Kitchen remodels

    They set up a little kitchen in our dining room with the old fridge and a sink cart. Seven weeks without a real kitchen was much easier knowing the exact day the counters would go in.

    Rebecca S. · Franklin Sample review

  • 04

    Whole-home renovations

    Our East Nashville bungalow had wiring from the 1940s. The rough-in inspection passed the first time and they sent me photos of every wall before the drywall closed it up. I still have them.

    Daniel K. · Nashville Sample review

  • 05

    Porches and screened rooms

    Screened porch on the back of the house, tied into the existing roof. A storm pushed the schedule back ten days and they told us right away and what it meant for the finish date.

    Monica R. · Hendersonville Sample review

  • 06

    Permits and inspections

    I had no idea what permits our bathroom needed. They handled the application, met the inspector and wrote the inspection dates on the report so I could be home for them.

    Trevor L. · Mount Juliet Sample review
